Vincent "Happy" Cervoni Schopenhauer (born November 23, 1991) is a retired French professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player and former Counter-Strike: Source player. He is known for leading Team LDLC.com and Team EnVyUs as the best French teams of their time, winning two Majors: DreamHack Winter 2014 with the former and DreamHack Open Cluj-Napoca 2015 with the latter. He retired on May 13, 2020 after forming StartedFromCS in VALORANT.

Trivia

[edit]

Personal

[edit]
  • Nearly retired after the first French Shuffle, when Titan and Epsilon eSports signed all of his teammates at Team LDLC.com.

Awards

[edit]
  • Was ranked the 10th best player of 2014 by HLTV. [3]
  • Was ranked the 8th best player of 2015 by HLTV. [4]

MVPs

[edit]
  • Was named the HLTV MVP of 4 tournaments; including 1 Major:
    • DreamHack Winter 2014 [5]
    • MLG X Games Aspen Invitational [6]
    • StarLadder StarSeries XII [7]
    • IEM gamescom 2015 [8]
